title: Vitae canonical career domain definitions
description: Shared, persistence-neutral definitions for canonical career-domain records.

entityId.description: Stable canonical identifier; adapters may keep their own storage identifiers separately.

uri.description: Adapter-resolvable location of the original source; it may be a vault, repository, upload, or external URI.

locator.description: Optional stable fragment, page range, line range, or heading within the source.

contentDigest.description: Optional algorithm-prefixed digest used to detect source drift without storing raw content.
